vip.v1.GetVIPStatusResponse.description:
GetVIPStatusResponse contains the authenticated caller-root VIP assignment
 and the qualification facts available for that assignment.

aopTier.description:
Tier earned from rolling 30-day average portfolio value, in the inclusive
 range 0 through 10.
aopTier.title: aop_tier

averageAop30dUsd.description:
Rolling 30-day average portfolio value in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol. Omitted
 unless average_aop_quality.status is COMPLETE.
averageAop30dUsd.title: average_aop_30d_usd

averageAopQuality.description:
Completeness of the rolling 30-day average portfolio value. An incomplete
 average portfolio value keeps its previous tier. Omitted when the
 assignment carries no automatic qualification evidence, such as the
 default VIP0 tier of a new account.
averageAopQuality.title: average_aop_quality

effectiveFrom.description:
UTC time from which the explicit VIP assignment is effective. Omitted
 while a new account is using the default VIP0 tier.
effectiveFrom.title: effective_from

evaluatedAt.description:
UTC time at which the explicit assignment was evaluated. Omitted while a
 new account is using the default VIP0 tier.
evaluatedAt.title: evaluated_at

metricsAsOf.description:
UTC cutoff of the rolling metrics used for this assignment. Omitted when
 neither settled_volume_30d_usd nor average_aop_30d_usd is present.
metricsAsOf.title: metrics_as_of

nextTierThresholds.description:
Entry thresholds for the tier immediately above the effective tier.
 Omitted when the effective tier is VIP10.
nextTierThresholds.title: next_tier_thresholds

policyEffectiveFrom.description: UTC time at which the selected assignment policy became effective.
policyEffectiveFrom.title: policy_effective_from

policyVersion.description: Positive identifier of the VIP policy used for this assignment.
policyVersion.title: policy_version

settledVolume30dUsd.description:
Rolling 30-day settled spot volume in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol. When
 settled_volume_quality.status is PRICE_UNAVAILABLE, this is a lower bound
 that excludes executions without an admissible USD reference price.
 Omitted when settled_volume_quality is omitted or its status is
 INCOMPLETE_HISTORY.
settledVolume30dUsd.title: settled_volume_30d_usd

settledVolumeQuality.description:
Completeness of the rolling 30-day settled spot volume. An incomplete
 volume metric can raise the volume tier when its proven lower bound meets
 a higher threshold, but it never lowers the tier. Omitted when the
 assignment carries no automatic qualification evidence, such as the
 default VIP0 tier of a new account.
settledVolumeQuality.title: settled_volume_quality

tier.description: Effective VIP tier in the inclusive range 0 through 10.
tier.title: tier

volumeTier.description:
Tier earned from rolling 30-day settled spot volume, in the inclusive
 range 0 through 10.
volumeTier.title: volume_tier

vip.v1.GetVIPStatusResponse.title: GetVIPStatusResponse

vip.v1.ListVIPTiersResponse.description: ListVIPTiersResponse contains one complete, immutable VIP policy version.

effectiveFrom.description: UTC time at which this policy version became effective.
effectiveFrom.title: effective_from

policyVersion.description: Positive identifier of the returned VIP policy version.
policyVersion.title: policy_version

retentionThresholdBp.description:
Average portfolio value retention threshold in basis points. One basis
 point is 0.01%; valid values are 1 through 10000.
retentionThresholdBp.title: retention_threshold_bp

tiers.description:
Complete VIP0 through VIP10 catalog ordered by tier ascending. This is a
 naturally bounded 11-row snapshot and is not paginated.
tiers.title: tiers

vip.v1.ListVIPTiersResponse.title: ListVIPTiersResponse

vip.v1.NextVIPTierThresholds.description:
NextVIPTierThresholds contains the entry thresholds for the tier immediately
 above the caller's effective tier.

aopThresholdUsd.description:
Rolling 30-day average portfolio value entry threshold in USD, encoded as
 a positive base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.
aopThresholdUsd.title: aop_threshold_usd

tier.description: Numeric next tier in the inclusive range 1 through 10.
tier.title: tier

volumeThresholdUsd.description:
Rolling 30-day settled spot volume entry threshold in USD, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol.
volumeThresholdUsd.title: volume_threshold_usd

vip.v1.NextVIPTierThresholds.title: NextVIPTierThresholds

vip.v1.VIPMetricQuality.description:
VIPMetricQuality explains the completeness of one rolling 30-day
 qualification metric.

incompleteHours.description:
Number of hourly buckets in the rolling 720-hour window that are missing
 or incomplete. Zero when status is COMPLETE.
incompleteHours.title: incomplete_hours

vip.v1.VIPMetricQuality.title: VIPMetricQuality

vip.v1.VIPMetricStatus.description:
VIPMetricStatus describes how complete one rolling 30-day qualification
 metric is.
vip.v1.VIPMetricStatus.title: VIPMetricStatus

vip.v1.VIPTier.description: VIPTier describes one row in a complete VIP0 through VIP10 policy catalog.

aopThresholdUsd.description:
Rolling 30-day average portfolio value entry threshold in USD, encoded as
 a positive base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.
 Omitted for VIP0, which has no average portfolio value entry threshold.
aopThresholdUsd.title: aop_threshold_usd

makerFeeRatePercent.description:
Absolute maker fee rate before symbol-specific adjustments, encoded as a
 base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between
 -100 and 100 inclusive.
makerFeeRatePercent.title: maker_fee_rate_percent

takerFeeRatePercent.description:
Absolute taker fee rate before symbol-specific adjustments, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are
 between 0 and 100 inclusive.
takerFeeRatePercent.title: taker_fee_rate_percent

tier.description: Numeric VIP tier in the inclusive range 0 through 10.
tier.title: tier

volumeThresholdUsd.description:
Rolling 30-day settled spot volume entry threshold in USD, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol.
volumeThresholdUsd.title: volume_threshold_usd

vip.v1.VIPTier.title: VIPTier

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: Get VIP qualification status for the authenticated caller's root account. An API key needs READ_VIP_STATUS and must be scoped to the main account.
List the complete active VIP0 through VIP10 tier catalog.
